title: Add a planner-only 'task narrow' command that shrinks a pending task's file boundaries to sub-paths of its current ones
acceptance: task narrow ID --owner PLANNER --paths P... --reason R works only on a pending, unowned task; every new path equals or lies inside one of the current paths; duplicates, widening, empty reason and unchanged sets are rejected without mutating the registry.
The change is recorded in the task's path_history and in the event log; reservations, claims, transfers and other commands are unchanged.
Behavioural tests cover success, each rejection and that a narrowed task becomes claimable when only its old broad path conflicted; docs/planning.md documents the command.
